snippet.title: Liminal Lane Playthrough | My New Liminal Space / Backrooms Game | PC
snippet.description:
Liminal Lane Playthrough | My New Liminal Space / Backrooms Game | PC
#backrooms #liminalspace #gameplay #gaming #poolrooms #horror 

Buy Game - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3542420/Liminal_Lane/

Welcome to Liminal Lane
Liminal Lane is a short, single player, first person, atmospheric walking simulator.

A nostalgic, surreal experience exploring Liminal Spaces.

Uncover the secrets of Liminal Lane and escape the Lucid Dreams and Haunting Nightmares.

The Game features many different linear and unique Liminal levels with some puzzles and escape areas.

Explore 10 levels, each with unique environments, atmospheres, puzzles and characters. 


Explore themes of Childhood Nostalgia, Teenage Years, The Office Grind, Family Holidays and being alone.

Each level is either a trip down memory lane or a fall into madness.



Relax Watch Movies and Cartoons
Why not just relax in some areas and watch tv?

The game features some very old 1920s and 30s public domain cartoons and movies.

There may also be a classic movie reference or two.

The game has an emotional narrative that will reveal itself once the player has completed their journey.

The Game also features many of my original Oil paintings throughout.

Alex Kerr Painting

Liminal Lane has No Save System but is a short experience.



As a solo developer this is my first game, for anyone who follows my channel Ravenhome knows my huge interest in the Backrooms and Liminal spaces, so I'm very excited to have developed my own Liminal Space themed game:) Many thanks
